name: Chimps Palace
summary:
A brand-new Gorilla Tag fangame and a full remake of our classic Chimps Kingdom, inspired by the beloved 2022 fangame Monkeys Place!

Step inside a world full of fun, adventure, and endless possibilities. Explore exciting new modes, meet other players, and discover hidden surprises around every corner. Whether you’re climbing, swinging, or just hanging out, Chimps Palace offers something for everyone.

We’ve taken everything you loved about Chimps Kingdom and reimagined it with fresh features, improved game
